texts.zh:
指挥官[exercise_admiral.GetName]制定了一个舰队演习计划，这将涉及到我们相当部分的海军。[exercise_admiral.GetSheHe]为这场演习选择的地点是[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系，靠近[exercise_neighbor.GetName]的边界。

[exercise_neighbor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]或许会将这次演习视作一种挑衅，但是如果我们取消演习，我们的军队会认为我们过于软弱。毕竟，[exercise_system.GetName]是我们的领土，[exercise_neighbor.GetName]没有权力告诉我们在自己的地盘里什么能做，什么不能做。
texts.en:
Commander [exercise_admiral.GetName] has drawn up plans for a major fleet exercise that will involve a substantial portion of our navy. The location [exercise_admiral.GetSheHe] [exercise_admiral.GetHasHave] chosen for these maneuvers is the [exercise_system.GetName] system, which is close to the border of the [exercise_neighbor.GetName].

The [exercise_neighbor.GetSpeciesNamePlural] may see this as a major provocation, but if we cancel the exercise our military will consider it a sign of weakness. After all, [exercise_system.GetName] lies within our space - the [exercise_neighbor.GetName] has no right to tell us what we can or cannot do in our own backyard.

label.en: Carry out the maneuvers as planned.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现负责此次演习的指挥官。
note.en: In the game, the commander in charge of this exercise appears here.

note.zh: 游戏会按这位人物的性别选用代词。

texts.zh:
主力舰队已按计划开入靠近[exercise_neighbor.GetName]边界的[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系。这次演习主要是模拟[exercise_neighbor.GetSpeciesName]军队在入侵之前向我方边界内发射探测器。

一旦所有参演部队到达[exercise_location.GetName]轨道的预定位置，演习就会开始。
texts.en:
Major fleet maneuvers have been planned in the [exercise_system.GetName] system, close to the border of the [exercise_neighbor.GetName]. The purpose of this exercise is to simulate a hostile probe by significant [exercise_neighbor.GetSpeciesName] forces into our space, as a possible prelude to an invasion.

The exercise will begin once all of the allocated forces have reached the initial staging area in orbit of [exercise_location.GetName].

texts.zh: [exercise_fleet.GetName]在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系举行的演习已经结束。指挥官[exercise_admiral.GetName]报告说，我们从演习中获益颇丰，这很大程度上归功于此次演习规模之巨大。尽管可能会有一些的外交上面的负面影响，但至少此次军演所积累的军事经验是非常宝贵的。
texts.en: The fleet maneuvers conducted by the [exercise_fleet.GetName] in the [exercise_system.GetName] system have been concluded. Commander [exercise_admiral.GetName] reports that we have learned much from this exercise, in large part due to its immense scale. Despite any potential diplomatic repercussions, the military benefits, at least, have been substantial.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现负责此次演习的指挥官。
note.en: In the game, the commander in charge of this exercise appears here.

note.en: In the game, the name of this fleet appears here.

texts.zh: 鉴于从[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系收到的[From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]军用加密信号突然减少，[From.Owner.GetName]在那里举行的舰队演习终于结束了。
texts.en: Judging by the sudden drop in coded [From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] military transmissions coming from the [exercise_system.GetName] system, the naval exercise that was being held there by the [From.Owner.GetName] has finally come to an end.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现另一个帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the other empire appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现对方物种的名称。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会显示演习所在恒星系的名字。
note.en: In the game, the name of the exercise star system appears here.

texts.zh: 主力舰队的演习计划已被取消。舰队长时间未能进入预定地点，这严重影响到整个舰队的战备水平。
texts.en: The plans to hold a major fleet exercise have been canceled. Continuous delays in moving the allocated forces into position means that to proceed now would seriously impair the readiness level of the entire fleet.

texts.zh: 根据指挥官[exercise_admiral.GetName]所制定的演习计划，目前我们的舰队正在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系进行演习。在演习期间，发生了几次军舰之间的碰撞事故。所幸船员伤亡极少，相关军舰也没有遭受严重损伤，不过受损舰船仍需要进行修复。
texts.en: The complex maneuvers devised by Commander [exercise_admiral.GetName] have resulted in several minor collisions during the naval drills currently being held in the [exercise_system.GetName] system. Crew casualties were minimal and none of the involved ships suffered critical damage, but they will require some yard work upon the conclusion of the exercise.

label.en: At least no ships were lost.

tooltips.zh: 我们的几艘军舰因碰撞而受到损伤。
tooltips.en: Several of our ships have sustained damage from collisions.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现负责此次演习的指挥官。
note.en: In the game, the commander in charge of this exercise appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会显示演习所在恒星系的名字。
note.en: In the game, the name of the exercise star system appears here.

texts.zh: 当舰队在[exercise_system.GetName]进行演习时，[destroyed_ship_1.GetName]和[destroyed_ship_2.GetName]军舰意外高速相撞。两艘军舰的船员全部遇难，我们心情沉重，已将这个消息通知了他们的家属。
texts.en: The [destroyed_ship_1.GetName] and the [destroyed_ship_2.GetName] were both tragically lost with all hands when the two starships collided during a high-speed maneuver that was part of the ongoing [exercise_system.GetName] naval drills. Next of kin have been notified.

tooltips.zh: 我们的两艘军舰因意外相撞而损失。
tooltips.en: Two of our ships have been lost due to an accidental collision.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这艘舰船的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this ship appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这艘舰船的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this ship appears here.

texts.zh: [officer_ship.GetName]的舰长[exercise_officer.GetName]在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系进行的舰队演习中表现了其出色的能力。这位军官表现出极强的领导才能，军方高层认为应立即提拔[exercise_officer.GetHerHim]为舰队司令。
texts.en: Captain [exercise_officer.GetName] of the [officer_ship.GetName] has shown a great deal of promise during the ongoing fleet exercises in the [exercise_system.GetName] system. The young officer has displayed initiative along with considerable leadership abilities, and the Admiralty has seen fit to immediately promote [exercise_officer.GetHerHim] to flag rank.

label.zh: 舰队总会需要有能力的指挥官。
label.en: The fleet is always in need of capable commanders.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这艘舰船的名称。
note.en: In the game, the ship's name appears here.

texts.zh: 在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系进行的舰队演习吸引了[Root.Capital.GetName]和各个殖民地上相当多的媒体关注。非秘密的全息影像全面的展示了[Root.GetName]舰队勇士的英姿，无数的志愿者因此涌向了我们的征兵站点！
texts.en: The ongoing naval drills in the [exercise_system.GetName] system have attracted considerable media attention on [Root.Capital.GetName] and the colonies. Unclassified holo recordings showing some of the more dramatic maneuvers have made the public enamored with the valiant defenders of the [Root.GetName] serving in the fleet. Volunteers are flocking to our naval recruitment stations!

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的首都名称。
note.en: In the game, your capital's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会显示演习所在恒星系的名字。
note.en: In the game, the name of the exercise star system appears here.

texts.zh: 我们已经收到了[From.Owner.GetName]大量的舰队活动情报报告。他们集中在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系，似乎接近我们的边界。[From.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]想要做什么？
texts.en: We have received intelligence reports of significant fleet movements within the [From.Owner.GetName]. They seem to be centered on the [exercise_system.GetName] system - suspiciously close to our border. What are the [From.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] up to?

note.en: In the game, the star system where the exercise is held appears here.

texts.zh:
我们的情报人员收集了更多在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系不断增加的[From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]舰队活动的情报。[From.Owner.GetName]似乎聚集了一支庞大的舰队，以前所未有的规模进行着舰队演习.

到目前为止，还没有迹象表明此次演习将转化为对[Root.GetName]的直接军事行动，但靠近我方边界的军事行动必然被看作是蓄意挑衅！我们应该如何回应？
texts.en:
Our intelligence assets have gathered more information on the increased [From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] naval activity in the [exercise_system.GetName] system. The [From.Owner.GetName] seems to have gathered a large fleet there to conduct some kind of massive naval exercise on an unprecedented scale.

As of yet there are no signs that this exercise will translate into direct military operations against the [Root.GetName], its proximity to our border can only be seen as a deliberate provocation! How should we respond?

tooltips.zh: 我们严重抗议[From.Owner.GetName]的行为，对他们表示强烈谴责与不满。
tooltips.en: We make our displeasure at these exercises known to the [From.Owner.GetName].

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现另一个帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the other empire appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现对方物种的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the other empire's species appears here.

note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会显示演习所在恒星系的名字。
note.en: In the game, the name of the exercise star system appears here.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]以最强硬的措辞对目前正在[exercise_system.GetName]星系举行演习的[Root.GetSpeciesName]舰队表示抗议和不满。

如此规模空前的舰队演习，如此接近我们的边界，这只能被理解为一种几乎不加遮掩的威胁与挑衅。我们的部队已经处于最高警戒状态，我们的舰队司令被命令以最强有力的军事回应应对任何边境的侵犯。
texts.en:
The [From.GetName] objects in the strongest possible terms to the provocative military exercise currently being held in the [exercise_system.GetName] system by [Root.GetSpeciesName] naval units.

To stage fleet maneuvers on such an unprecedented scale so close to our borders can only be construed as a thinly veiled threat. Our own forces have been placed on maximum alert, and our fleet commanders have been instructed to respond to any border violations with overwhelming force.

label.zh: 告诉[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]不要干涉我们的内政！
label.en: Tell the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to stay out of our affairs!

tooltips.zh: 对于他们卑微的抗议，我们将回应以最强硬的态度。
tooltips.en: We make a hard-line diplomatic response to their obnoxious little protest.

label.zh: 我们无法承担后果……取消演习。
label.en: We can't afford an incident... cancel the exercise.

tooltips.zh: 我们取消了正在举行的舰队演习，以便改善与[From.GetName]的关系。军方一定会对此表示不满。
tooltips.en: We cancel our ongoing fleet maneuvers to improve relations with the [From.GetName]. The military will not be pleased.

label.zh: 我们的外交官会缓和局面。
label.en: Our diplomats will smooth things over.

tooltips.zh: 我们将采取温和的回应以减轻外交伤害，但舰队演习仍将继续。
tooltips.en: We make a conciliatory response to lessen the diplomatic damage, but the exercise continues.

note.en: In the game, the name of the other empire appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现对方物种的复数名称。
note.en: In the game, the plural name of the other species appears here.

texts.zh:
我们收到了你们对在[exercise_system.GetName]举行演习的英勇无敌舰队发出的措辞不当的抗议。正如你们所知，那个恒星系位于[From.GetName]的主权范围内，所以我们不认为那里发生的事与你们有任何关系。

顺便提醒一下，[Root.GetName]最好能老老实实的管好自己并保证以后也不会给我们发送如此鲁莽、充满挑衅的外交文书。

通讯结束。
texts.en:
We have received your poorly phrased objection to the military exercises our glorious naval forces are currently conducting in the [exercise_system.GetName] system. Since that system, as you are no doubt aware, lies well within the sovereign territory of the [From.GetName], we do not see how what transpires there could possibly be any of your business.

The [Root.GetName] would do well not to send us any more such provocative and reckless diplomatic correspondence in the future.

This transmission ends now.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现发来这条消息的帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the empire that sent this message appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会显示演习所在恒星系的名字。
note.en: In the game, the name of the exercise star system appears here.

texts.zh:
由于[Root.GetName]对在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系进行的舰队演习表示抗议，[From.GetName]已决定终止所有正在进行的舰队演习，以增进两个星际国家之间的良好关系。

我们真诚地希望，这次行动将有助于缓和星际间的紧张局势，同时这将毫无疑问地证明，[From.GetSpeciesName]致力于星系的持久和平。
texts.en:
In light of the objections voiced by the [Root.GetName] to our naval maneuvers in the [exercise_system.GetName] system, the [From.GetName] has decided to terminate all ongoing exercises in the interest of fostering better relations between our two star nations.

It is our sincere hope that this action will help to defuse interstellar tensions while proving beyond doubt the [From.GetSpeciesName] commitment towards a lasting galactic peace.

label.zh: 也许他们真的在追寻和平……
label.en: Perhaps they are earnest in their quest for peace...

texts.zh:
我们在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系进行的军事演习受到了[From.GetName]的误解，对此我们深表遗憾。

此次演习系按预定计划进行，进行的地点亦由指挥官随机挑选，不针对任何人或任何势力。该演习绝不应被过度解读为对[Root.GetName]的威胁或挑衅。
texts.en:
The [From.GetName] deeply regrets any misunderstandings our ongoing military exercises in the [exercise_system.GetName] system might have caused.

These naval drills were planned well in advance, and the location was chosen at random by our commanders. In no way should this be construed as some kind of threat or provocation directed at the [Root.GetName].

label.zh: 也许这是[From.GetSpeciesName]的另一个诡计？

summary.text:
# 舰队演习 / Fleet Maneuvers
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 外交事件 diplomatic event

## 如何开始 How it starts

随机事件（平均 320 个月一次）：游戏已过中期、本方是非附庸/非意识集合的普通国家，不在战争中，舰队实力>8000，有指挥官；边境某星系与一个有通讯、非同种族、非友好/保护/忠诚的邻国相邻；每国一次（fleet_exercise 标志，邻国 exercise_neighbor）。/ A random event (mean 320 months) for a non-gestalt, non-subject empire with fleet power > 8000 and a commander; needs a neighbouring country in contact that is not friendly, protected or loyal; once per country.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. **舰队演习（1000）**：A 进行演习：按舰队实力启用特殊项目 FLEET_MANEUVERS_1/2/3（实力 1600–4000 / 4000–10000 / >10000）；B 取消（1800 天“演习取消”修正）。/ Run maneuvers (project tier by fleet power) or cancel.
2. 演习期间随机出现 **1011 碰撞 / 1012 损失舰船 / 1013 有前途的军官 / 1014 公众关注**（各 25%）；约 10–15 天后 **1006 [星系]的海军活动**（邻国视角）；项目成功 → **1025 演习结束**，对方收到 **1026**；失败 → **1001 演习取消**；约 60–90 天后邻国情报 **1020 → 1021 通讯 → 1022 / 1023 / 1024**（三选一对话）。/ Random incidents, the neighbour’s view (1006), success (1025 / 1026), cancel (1001) and a later diplomatic exchange (1020 → 1021 → 1022/1023/1024).

1011–1014 互斥（各 25%）；1022/1023/1024 对应 1021 的三个选项。/ 1011–1014 exclusive (25% each); 1022–1024 are the three options of 1021.
